[[Lorelle's Longbow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[bow]] dropped by [[Lorelle Jade Cutter]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Rhea's Crater]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:Lengthens [[Poison]] duration on foes by 33% (Stacking)
:[[Armor rating|Armor]] +7 (vs. [[physical damage]])

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Jade Longbow]].
